_comment: Per-case gate thresholds for scripts/eval.js. Keys are '<topdir>/<file stem>' as eval prints them: examples/designs/x → 'examples/x', recipe/x → 'recipe/x', examples/intake/x.req.json → 'intake/x'. 'copper': true builds that case with --route --pour so the router + pour path stays under regression while the shipped default is placement-only.
